tool_workarounds.reason: cddl 0.10.7 rejects every entry matched by a wildcard member whose key is a type choice, e.g. { * (int / tstr) => any }, with 'unexpected key'. It also cannot combine two wildcard members (* int => any, * tstr => any). The schema keeps the RFC 8610 form; the validator is given the looser any key, which differs only by also admitting byte string, boolean and null keys in the two header maps that allow unknown labels.

cddl 0.10.7 matches .regexp at the start of the string only (a prefix match), so 'x-acme_ledger' would pass; RFC 8610 says the pattern must match the whole string. The validator is given an explicit end anchor.
